dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pyjn](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pyjn) Magnitude 5.8 earthquake at 94.75 depth occurred on May 11 2025 29km W of Blangkejeren. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 3.8987 longitude 97.0973. It impacted 165287 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
